input.summary: Yaba Market Store, Dry Goods shelf: 1 of 5 planogram SKUs out (Golden Penny Spaghetti 500g, 0 of 4 facings), compliance 80%, no unknown products. Inventory check shows 15 units of Golden Penny Spaghetti in the back against a reorder point of 6 — this is a shelf-refill job, not a stock problem, so no purchase order was created. Separately, Dangote Spaghetti 500g shows 3 facings on shelf but only 2 units on hand (reorder point 6); because the audit confidence is very low (0.37) I did not auto-order, and instead flagged it to the manager to confirm the count before a 2-case (24 unit) order is raised.
